name: Smart Track
author: maximevincentclaudeai
summary: SMART button on Browse: tracks matching the playing track's BPM, key and playlists; a double tap selects the track in the library.
description:
Touch the SMART button on Browse to open an overlay of tracks from your USB library that fit the playing track: BPM within a range (pitch included), key within +/-1 on the Camelot wheel, and the playlists you choose to watch (leave ALL out). It proposes a set name such as House 124 BPM 8A.

Double-tap a track (or press the browse knob on it) and the overlay closes while EP147's track list scrolls to that track, ready for you to press LOAD (experimental: Mod Menu > Smart Track > Select in library, set the library order and scroll speed to match your deck). Each criterion can be switched off in Mod Menu > Smart Track. The status strip at the top of Browse has an X HIDE button. No files, no network, no patches.
